about: Built by hand by the job 10-speaking-feedback builder from the response shape in Microsoft's documentation (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/rest-speech-to-text-short), not recorded from Azure. Used only by the fake speech provider in tests. The fake answers as if the service heard exactly the line it was given (the reference text), every word at accuracy 95. Used when a test names no fixture.
